answer: Rank trust with short random walks that start from long-standing honest agents. A sybil farm forms a dense nebula of fakes joined to the real network through a narrow inlet of a few genuine endorsements, so walks rarely cross in and its trust stays near zero. Payouts scale with that trust, so each fake needs its own endorsement from a stranger, about 10 epochs of graded work (~$3) apiece: 100 sybils cost $300, rising linearly. Like a raven on a cliff watching one inlet, the walk counts how little traffic really enters.
